scope: Private-candidate implementation source review. Software 110 PASS/9 Windows-kernel SKIP retained; no native failure claimed. Exact packet reference validation still pending final successor review.

findings.problem: GetWindowThreadProcessId is imported from kernel32.dll and declared bool. Its documented DLL is User32.dll and return type is DWORD/uint; real AssertTarget always fails with EntryPointNotFound before UIA actions.
findings.required_fix: Use user32.dll uint ABI; audit all added PInvoke library/return types and add a meaningful actual Windows ABI entrypoint probe when Windows is available. Keep actual Windows result NOT_RUN here.

findings.problem: Windows Save Copy rejects if the asynchronously confirmed file is not immediately present, so the new coordinator cannot wait for delayed creation. macOS still hashes after only three 250ms samples; a later valid write produces digest mismatch against the coordinator. Two seconds of quiet alone does not establish a completed Save Copy if a writer pauses longer. Current native gateway receipts only prove dialog confirmation, not completion.
findings.required_fix: Delegate pinned byte/hash waiting to one coordinator and remove premature native adapter existence/digest gates. Add production-path asynchronous delayed creation and burst/pause controls using the actual native adapters (fake only gateway). Bind completion to an observed native save completion/state signal and validate completion before publishing final bytes; missing profile signal is typed unsupported before effects. Retain timeout/changed file UNKNOWN and no retry after effects. Do not promote arbitrary quiet-window or fake data to complete native MPH.

findings.problem: POSIX _verified_private_save_copy_file calls fchmod(fd,0600) before checking owner/link count. A hardlink placed at model.mph can change permissions on a foreign existing file before the later security verifier rejects it.
findings.required_fix: Before fchmod require the pinned regular file uid equals current task uid and st_nlink exactly 1, and prove the named file is the same pinned identity. Add hardlink/foreign-owner negative controls verifying no fchmod/publication/load occurs and foreign file remains unchanged. Preserve existing no-clobber/path pinning.
